heading: Professional services & agencies use cases
intro: Every use case comes from a real Fruition client engagement, with the client's name withheld. Select "See the build" for the process diagram, boards, automations and integrations.

faq.question: What do professional services & agencies organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 70 professional services & agencies use cases. The most common are integrations & migration (47), work & project management (39), CRM (27), most often for sales & CRM, operations & delivery, finance & procurement teams.

faq.question: How long does a professional services & agencies monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete professional services & agencies build is 3 to 6 months. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do professional services & agencies builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in professional services & agencies use cases are Make, monday.com, Slack, Gmail, n8n, Xero.

faq.question: Does Fruition build AI agents for professional services & agencies?
faq.answer: Yes. 23 of the professional services & agencies use cases on this page include an AI step. Examples: Incoming request → AI request scoring (demoed); AI categorisation tags incoming requests by type from email body (design, social, web, print, troubleshooting); Content pillar or search-gap trigger → multi-agent n8n workflow retrieves context → Claude drafts blogs and LinkedIn posts.

automations: Project number → pulls Xero invoices, supplier bills, credit notes and spend-money transactions into the project (Make.com), on scheduled polling or manual row refresh with retries

process.title: Xero financials pulled into project boards

steps.label: Invoices, bills and credit notes pulled
Invoiced, cost and unpaid totals updated
Financials beside delivery, no Xero login
